description: Single source of truth for the myClinic <-> Central wire vocabulary: tier ids, the myClinic plan each tier entitles, seat limits, the SQL fallback branch, the validator's no-lease and local-mode defaults, and every refusal code sync_clinic_subscription() can answer with. Central derives MYCLINIC_TIER_ENTITLEMENTS / TIER_CATALOG / SYNC_REFUSAL_HINTS from this file; the client mirrors CENTRAL_TIER_TO_PLAN and its diagnostic vocabulary against it; supabase/schema.sql keeps its own case statement and a drift test parses it.

standard.label: Standard · Default Node
standard.hint: Baseline single-site self-hosted installation (5 doctors · 3 front-desk)

enterprise.label: Enterprise · Dedicated SLA
enterprise.hint: Unlimited seats, multi-cluster HA & priority SLA

SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND.label: No match
SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND.hint: The client called but nothing matched. Compare the email and Clinic URL it claimed with the pinned values — on a dual-pinned row BOTH must match exactly.

ORIGIN_MISMATCH.label: Origin blocked
ORIGIN_MISMATCH.hint: The browser Origin header disagreed with the claimed Clinic URL. Open the app from its real deployed address, not a proxy, tunnel or preview host.

INVALID_ORIGIN.label: Bad Clinic URL
INVALID_ORIGIN.hint: The claimed Clinic URL is not scheme + host. It must look like https://clinic.github.io — no path, no trailing slash.

INVALID_EMAIL.label: Bad owner email
INVALID_EMAIL.hint: The claimed owner email is malformed. Fix the owner row in the clinic app, then let it re-sync.

MISSING_IDENTITY.label: No identity sent
MISSING_IDENTITY.hint: The client sent neither an owner email nor a Clinic URL. Sign in as the clinic owner, or pin a URL-only subscription.

RATE_LIMITED.label: Rate limited
RATE_LIMITED.hint: Too many calls from this network: Central allows 60/min and 15 unmatched lookups per 5 min. Wait, then re-check.

SEAT_LIMIT_REACHED.label: Seats full
SEAT_LIMIT_REACHED.hint: Every deployment seat is taken. Raise the device limit or revoke a stale node.

SUBSCRIPTION_PAUSED.label: Paused
SUBSCRIPTION_PAUSED.hint: The kill-switch is on for this subscription. Resume it and the client writes again on its next sync.

SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED.label: Expired
SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED.hint: The contract end date has passed. Renew the subscription.

SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE.label: Not active
SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE.hint: The subscription status is not active. Set the status back to active.
